name: RestoreVerificationAndCommitV1
preconditions: operator explicitly selects backup source; managed source is governed artifact file, portable source is governed *.somabackupset directory and requires portable recovery secret
restore runs in maintenance/quiescing flow with no ordinary mutation accepted
source path and every set member are untrusted input and opened without modifying them
verify_before_live_mutation: classify source by governed format without trusting extension alone

portable: require one ordinary non-reparse set directory with exactly payload.somabackup, manifest.json and auth.json; missing, duplicate, unexpected, symlink/reparse or non-regular member fails BACKUP_SET_INCOMPLETE before payload use

portable: parse bounded canonical SOMA_PORTABLE_BACKUP_MANIFEST_V1 and SOMA_PORTABLE_BACKUP_AUTH_V1 with duplicate/unknown fields rejected; require matching backup_id and governed literal member names
portable: read payload authenticated public header sufficiently to obtain governed format/version/backup_id/KDF salt and require manifest/header backup_id match

portable: derive detached-auth key with HKDF-SHA256(recovery_secret, payload public salt, info=SOMA-BACKUP-PORTABLE-AUTH-V1); recompute canonical manifest SHA-256 and constant-time HMAC-SHA-256 tag; mismatch returns nondisclosing BACKUP_TAMPERED/BACKUP_SECRET_INVALID policy
portable: verify exact payload size, SHA-256 and authenticated-header SHA-256 from detached manifest; construct PortableBackupSetFingerprintV1 and freeze it for preview/revalidation
managed: parse bounded governed artifact header and freeze artifact SHA-256 as source fingerprint
derive portable KEK or unwrap managed root only for recognized kind
authenticate wrapped backup key with header AAD; wrong secret/tamper uses bounded nondisclosing failure
authenticate/decrypt every record/chunk to fresh isolated staging root; reject duplicate/missing/out-of-order indexes, nonce/length/size violations and path traversal
decrypt key record to obtain source live DEK and require source data_instance_id match authenticated header/internal manifest
authenticate encrypted internal manifest and verify chunk/snapshot SHA-256 plus complete file inventory
open staged database only through SQLCipher provider with recovered live DEK and exact cipher profile
run LLD-01 database restore verification: SQLite integrity/foreign-key/schema/migration/audit protections and supported-origin/future-version checks
construct RestorePreviewV1 and require explicit confirmation bound to backup_id + verified_source_fingerprint + target current data_instance revision
commit: freshly revalidate current instance ownership/quiescing state and preview fingerprint

portable: reopen complete set and re-prove exact PortableBackupSetFingerprintV1 including canonical manifest, HMAC and payload digest before quiescing/replacement; a missing/changed companion invalidates preview
managed: re-prove exact artifact SHA-256 before replacement
create emergency pre-restore managed backup of current live state when a valid current database exists; it must verify before replacement
ask LLD-01 replace_live_database_from_verified_stage using atomic/recoverable file choreography while holding canonical instance ownership
after replacement re-open restored DB with recovered DEK and rerun cipher + schema/integrity verification
DPAPI-protect recovered DEK to target installation live-data-key envelope only as part of recoverable publication choreography
preserve restored data_instance_id; generate new run/session identities on next readiness

inside the recovery-finalization UnitOfWork invoke LLD-01 DurableJobCoordinator.reconcile_restored_jobs before any coordinator may claim work; every restored queued/running/waiting_review/retry_wait job becomes cancelled historical technical state with RESTORE_SNAPSHOT_JOB_INVALIDATED, and restored running claims receive interrupted attempt evidence when not already represented

inside the same recovery-finalization UnitOfWork reconcile managed_backup_catalog: when restoring a managed artifact, require its authenticated backup_id row to exist and transition that row to restored with the verified artifact SHA-256/verification time and revision+1; every other row left in building or verifying by the historical snapshot transitions to failed with failure_code=RESTORE_SNAPSHOT_JOB_INVALIDATED and revision+1; verified/pruned/restored/failed historical rows otherwise remain unchanged

in that same recovery-finalization boundary append the restore command receipt plus required security.backup_restored audit/result evidence only after restored-job and managed-backup-catalog reconciliation succeed
commit recovery finalization, then permit normal readiness/startup; no historical nonterminal job from the backup may execute implicitly
retain emergency pre-restore backup; normal rotation may consider it only after restored instance is verified ready
failure: before live replacement: live database/key envelope untouched; incomplete portable set or detached authenticity failure is always non-mutating; after replacement but before recovery finalization: runtime remains non-READY and job claims remain disabled; any failure in restored-job/catalog reconciliation or receipt/audit finalization triggers recoverable choreography back to the prior verified live files/key envelope when possible, otherwise startup stays blocked with emergency backup available
rules: never decrypt directly over live paths
portable payload.somabackup alone is not a restorable portable backup
detached manifest/auth verification precedes portable payload authority and cannot be skipped by user confirmation
never accept a future schema by rewriting manifests
portable recovery secret/live DEK/backup key/detached-auth key never enter database/audit/diagnostics
restore does not convert Alpha database/backup into supported Beta origin
historical durable-job coordination state is not business truth and is never automatically resumed after restore
a managed backup is allowed to contain its own pre-verification catalog/job state because restore finalization deterministically reconciles that technical state before READY
completed/failed/cancelled restored job history remains intact; new desired work must be explicitly scheduled after READY
